description: Swap the planned dinner on a date to another dish suggested for that day, by its title. A recipe from the household's library by its exact title also works, on a day nobody has planned yet too: the week opens around it. A title that does not match fails with the dishes to choose from.

dishTitle.description: Title of the dish to switch to: one of the day's suggestions, or a recipe in the library.

name: replace_dinner
title: Swap a dinner
